kubejs.skill.thermoregulation.descriptio: Control the flow of heat and cold magicules within the body. Halves hyperthermia and hypothermia damage and neutralises biome temperature penalties. Mastered: complete immunity to temperature extremes and their debuffs. Drains 2 magicules per 5 seconds in extreme biomes.
kubejs.skill.purification.description: Spiritual digestion filters parasites from untreated or salt water and slows thirst by half. Mastered (True Sustenance): converts magicules directly into hydration, removing the need to drink.
kubejs.skill.adaptive_carapace.descripti: A hardened magicule coating shields each limb. Reduces damage to the head, torso, arms and legs before locational damage is applied and resists fractures from blunt hits by giant monsters.
